scenes.text: A car dealer named Rick is in your office with a brochure for a {pop_car} in 'Champion Gold'. 'You've earned it,' he says. You have not earned it. You want it anyway.
scenes.speaker: Rick from the dealership

choices.label: Buy it ({$fee})
choices.result: It's gold. It's loud. It does not fit in your parking space.

choices.label: Lease something sensible
choices.result: A sedan. Beige. The fighters make fun of you for a month.

scenes.text: {president}'S GOLD SUPERCAR SPOTTED PARKED ACROSS FOUR DISABLED SPACES OUTSIDE {pop_food}; INTERNET FURIOUS

choices.label: Apologize and donate the car to charity
choices.result: The charity auctions it to a fighter. The fighter parks it worse.

choices.label: 'I was getting nuggets, sue me'
choices.result: Some people respect it. The disability advocates do not.

scenes.text: It's your anniversary. You're at a weigh-in. Your spouse has called four times. The fifth call is a voicemail that just says your full name, slowly.
scenes.speaker: Your spouse

choices.label: Leave the weigh-in and go home
choices.result: You hand the weigh-in to your matchmaker. He weighs himself by accident.

choices.label: Send flowers and stay
choices.result: Flowers. Expensive flowers. The card says 'sorry, weigh-in'.

scenes.text: Dinner at home. Your phone buzzes 41 times. You don't look at it once. Your spouse notices. It's the best night you've had in months.

choices.label: Promise more nights like this
choices.result: You mean it. You'll try. The phone will win sometimes.

scenes.text: Your spouse has moved into the guest room 'temporarily'. The dog has picked a side. It isn't yours.

choices.label: Book couples therapy
choices.result: The therapist asks what you do. You explain. She asks if you've considered not doing that.

choices.label: Throw yourself into work
choices.result: The promotion has never run better. Your house has never been quieter.

scenes.text: A casino host has comped you a suite, a table, and 'unlimited markers'. 'High rollers like you deserve high limits,' she says. You are not a high roller. You are a guy with a promotion.
scenes.speaker: Casino host Destiny

choices.label: Play
choices.result: You play blackjack until the sun comes up. You don't remember the last six hands.

choices.label: Go to bed
choices.result: Asleep by 11. You've never felt older or wiser.

scenes.text: You wake up in the suite. There's a marker on the nightstand. It's for {$fee}. There's also a parrot. Nobody knows where the parrot came from.

choices.label: Pay the marker
choices.result: Paid. The parrot is coming home with you, apparently.

choices.label: Negotiate it down
choices.result: Destiny is disappointed in you. The parrot is too.

scenes.text: A network wants you to host a weekly podcast called 'Boss Talk'. You'd talk about the fights, the business, and 'your vibe'. They promise it'll be 'just two hours, max'.
scenes.speaker: Podcast producer

choices.label: Do it
choices.result: Episode one is four hours long. You talk about elk for some reason.

choices.label: Pass
choices.result: Your rival gets a podcast instead. It's bad. It's very popular.

scenes.text: {president}'S PODCAST CAUSES STORM AFTER HE SAYS JUDGES SHOULD 'BE REPLACED BY THREE DOGS AND A COIN'

choices.label: Stand by it
choices.result: 'Three Dogs and a Coin' becomes a fan chant.

choices.label: Apologize to the commission
choices.result: The commission accepts your apology. One commissioner asks if he can be one of the dogs.

scenes.text: {ref} UNDER FIRE: fans compile a 14-minute video of every late stoppage in his career. It's set to sad music. It has 6 million views.

choices.label: Demand a ref review from the commission
choices.result: The commission schedules a hearing. The ref schedules a podcast appearance.

choices.label: Defend the ref publicly
choices.result: The video gets a sequel. Now it's 22 minutes.

scenes.text: At the hearing, {ref} defends himself with a 40-slide presentation titled 'Let Them Fight: A Philosophy'. Slide 31 is just a picture of a lion.

choices.label: Accept his explanation
choices.result: He keeps his job. He stops one fight early the next week out of spite.

choices.label: Push for retraining
choices.result: He's sent to a seminar. He comes back with a certificate and the same philosophy.

scenes.text: The commission has appointed a new judge: a retired accountant who has never watched MMA. 'I'll learn on the job,' he says. His first assignment is your main event.
scenes.speaker: Commission office

choices.label: Request a different judge
choices.result: Request denied. He bought a book about MMA. He's on chapter one.

choices.label: Send him a training package
choices.result: DVDs, a rulebook, and a box of chocolates. He sends a thank-you note.

scenes.text: The accountant judge scores your main event... correctly. Every round. The crowd is so stunned they boo out of habit. Then cheer. Then boo again.

choices.label: Send him a thank-you card
choices.result: He's assigned to every big fight from now on. Fighters start sending him chocolates. That's probably a problem.

scenes.text: A new anti-doping agency is offering to run your testing program. They're strict. Very strict. They test for things that haven't been invented yet.
scenes.speaker: The Board
scenes.title: MEMO: ANTI-DOPING

choices.label: Sign up
choices.result: Your fighters receive welcome packets. Several fighters 'retire' immediately.

choices.label: Keep the old lax system
choices.result: The old system tests for 'vibes'.

scenes.text: First quarter of the new program: 3 positive tests, 1 fighter claiming his 'twin' took the test, and 1 fighter who tested positive for an elk supplement recommended by Blow Hogan on air.
scenes.speaker: The Board
scenes.title: TESTING REPORT

choices.label: Publish the results
choices.result: The sport respects you more. The roster respects you less.

choices.label: Handle it quietly
choices.result: Quiet. For now.

scenes.text: The CEO of {rival.name} posted: '{promotion} is a minor league with a major ego. Their champion couldn't win our prelims.' The post has 400,000 likes.

choices.label: Clap back publicly
choices.result: Your response is one word and a picture of your belt. It does numbers.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.result: Ignoring it is classy. Classy doesn't trend.

scenes.text: The rival CEO calls: 'Fine. Your champ vs our champ. Co-promoted. 50/50 split. Unless you're scared.'
scenes.speaker: Rival CEO

choices.label: Accept the super fight
choices.result: Champion vs champion. The biggest fight either promotion has ever made.

choices.label: Decline: 'come to our house'
choices.result: He calls you a coward. You call him a coward. Nobody fights.

scenes.text: Word is {rival.name} can't make payroll. Fighters are calling around. Half their roster could be free agents in a month.
scenes.speaker: Industry insider

choices.label: Quietly reach out to their best fighters
choices.result: Your phone is very busy this week.

choices.label: Offer them a loan
choices.result: Gracious. Possibly stupid.

scenes.text: EXODUS: TOP FIGHTERS FLEE {rival.name} AMID PAYROLL CRISIS; SEVERAL SPOTTED ENTERING {promotion} HQ WITH GYM BAGS

choices.label: Sign the best of them
choices.result: Your roster just got a lot deeper. Your existing fighters just got a lot nervous.

scenes.text: A boxing promoter wants your biggest star to box his biggest star. Boxing rules. Their gloves, their ring, their judges. 'It'll be the biggest event in history,' he promises, 'for us.'
scenes.speaker: Boxing promoter

choices.label: Agree to a 60/40 split
choices.result: Your fighter starts boxing training. Their footwork is 'a work in progress'.

choices.label: Only if it's MMA rules
choices.result: He laughs for a full minute. Then hangs up.

scenes.text: THE CROSSOVER: record-breaking PPV numbers for {promotion} star's boxing debut. Result is controversial. Boxing fans furious. MMA fans furious. Everyone paid.

choices.label: Demand a rematch under MMA rules
choices.result: The boxer suddenly has a very bad back.

choices.label: Take the money and move on
choices.result: You count the money. It counts back.

scenes.text: {subject.first} {subject.last} wants to open a gym and coach your fighters. 'I know things,' {he} says. {He} knows things. {He} also wants a percentage.
scenes.speaker: {subject.first} {subject.last}

choices.label: Partner with {him}
choices.result: The gym opens with a ribbon cutting. {He} cuts it with a spinning back kick.

choices.label: Pass
choices.result: {He} opens the gym anyway, across from your HQ. With a bigger sign.

scenes.text: Fighters training under {subject.first} {subject.last} are winning more, finishing more, and swearing more. {He} has taught them 'the dark arts'. You don't ask.

choices.label: Expand the program
choices.result: A second location. A merch line. {He}'s happier than {he} was as champion.

scenes.text: Legend {subject.first} {subject.last} says your current champion 'wouldn't have made it to the prelims in my era'. Your champion replied 'ok grandpa'. Legends worldwide are offended.

choices.label: Set up an exhibition
choices.result: Grandpa wants the smoke.

choices.label: Let them argue online
choices.result: It lasts a week. Everyone sells T-shirts.

scenes.text: The legend exhibition is three two-minute rounds with big gloves. The legend gets the champ in a headlock for 40 seconds and refuses to let go. The crowd chants 'OK GRANDPA' lovingly.

choices.label: Book a sequel
choices.result: Everyone wants a sequel. Everyone's doctors don't.

choices.label: Retire the legend for good, with honors
choices.result: The legend retires with a standing ovation and a hip replacement scheduled.

scenes.text: Staff at the arena for your next event report 'cold spots', a disembodied voice yelling 'STAND THEM UP', and a mop that moves by itself. A paranormal TV show wants to film there during your event.
scenes.speaker: Arena manager

choices.label: Let them film
choices.result: A ghost hunter with a meter is coming to fight night.

choices.label: No ghosts on my broadcast
choices.result: The ghost is disappointed. Probably.

scenes.text: During the co-main, the lights flicker, the ghost hunter's meter spikes, and a ring card girl swears she saw a referee in 1990s clothing standing in the corner. The broadcast replays it 30 times.

choices.label: 'The Ghost Ref' becomes a mascot
choices.result: Ghost Ref merch outsells real ref merch. That's not hard.

scenes.text: Dozens of fans posted videos of 'lights' over the arena during your last event. Blow Hogan has done three podcast episodes about it. The FAA says it was a drone delivering {pop_food}.

choices.label: Lean into it: 'ALIEN NIGHT'
choices.result: Next event: green lights, a fog machine, and a fighter walking out in a tinfoil hat.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.result: The truth is out there. Nobody at {promotion} is looking for it.

scenes.text: ALIEN NIGHT is a huge hit. A fighter walks out in a full alien costume, takes it off mid-walk, and is still the weirdest thing in the arena: Blow Hogan wore an antenna headband all broadcast.

choices.label: Make it annual
choices.result: Every year. Same night. Same Blow.

scenes.text: A traveling circus promoter is offering a 'Man vs Bear' exhibition. The bear is 'very friendly, mostly'. The man is your heavyweight, if he agrees. He hasn't been asked.
scenes.speaker: Circus promoter Lou

choices.label: Absolutely not
choices.result: Lou is crestfallen. The bear is relieved.

choices.label: Ask the heavyweight (as a joke)
choices.result: You ask. He doesn't laugh. He asks how big.

scenes.text: Your heavyweight is in your office in a bear-print robe. 'I've been training for this my whole life. Every sparring session. Every hug.' He is serious.
scenes.speaker: Your heavyweight

choices.label: Shut it down for good
choices.result: He's disappointed. He gets a bear tattoo instead.

choices.label: Arrange a 'meeting' with the bear (supervised)
choices.result: The bear and the heavyweight hug for the cameras. Both seem to enjoy it. Nobody fights. Everyone wins.

scenes.text: Renovations at HQ uncover a time capsule buried by the promotion's founder. Inside: a VHS tape, a cassette labelled 'NEVER PLAY THIS', and a letter addressed 'to whoever runs this place in the future'.

choices.label: Read the letter on stream
choices.result: The letter says 'Dear future boss: sorry about the roof.' The roof has been leaking for 30 years.

choices.label: Rebury it
choices.result: Some things are better left buried. Like the cassette.

scenes.text: Against all advice, you play the cassette. It's the founder, singing a power ballad called 'Octagon of My Heart'. It's terrible. It's beautiful. The fighters demand it as a walkout song.

choices.label: Release it
choices.result: 'Octagon of My Heart' hits number one on the novelty charts.

scenes.text: The Owner's nephew, Brayden, needs 'real world experience'. He'll be your new Head of Matchmaking. He's 19. His qualifications include 'watching a lot of fights on TikTok'.
scenes.speaker: The Board
scenes.title: MEMO: STAFFING

choices.label: Give him the job (on paper)
choices.result: Brayden has a business card. It's laminated. He hands it to everyone.

choices.label: Push back
choices.result: The Owner asks if you have 'a problem with family'.

scenes.text: Brayden has booked a flyweight against a heavyweight because 'it would be crazy'. He's already announced it on his personal account. It has 2 million views.

choices.label: Cancel it and explain weight classes
choices.result: Brayden is devastated. He makes a video about it. More views.

choices.label: Turn it into a grappling exhibition
choices.result: The flyweight wins by heel hook in 40 seconds. Brayden is a genius now, according to Brayden.

scenes.text: REPORT: {owner} EXPLORING SALE OF {promotion}; BUYERS RUMOURED TO INCLUDE A SOVEREIGN WEALTH FUND, A STREAMING GIANT AND {pop_celeb}

choices.label: Reassure the staff
choices.result: You hold an all-hands meeting. Somebody asks if they'll keep their dental.

choices.label: Ask the Owner directly
choices.result: The Owner says 'no comment'. To you. His own president.

scenes.text: The Owner confirms: 'We are always listening to offers.' Then he adds: 'Make the number go up and nobody has to listen too hard.'
scenes.speaker: The Board
scenes.title: MEMO FROM THE OWNER

choices.label: Make the number go up
choices.result: Austerity mode. The catering is now sandwiches. Sad sandwiches.

choices.label: Make the product better instead
choices.result: You put money into the fights. The fights get better. The number takes longer.
